title: Date picker shows the wrong day in Australia/Sydney
body: Pick May 8 in the UI, server stores May 7. Probably a UTC offset bug. Other timezones look fine.
label: bug

title: Memory grows unbounded in the worker process
body: Heap snapshot after 24h shows 2.1 GB resident, mostly retained Buffer objects in the queue consumer. Restarting the worker brings it back to ~80 MB.
label: bug

title: Loading the dashboard is broken
body: Spinner just sits there forever. Tab eventually crashes. Was working last week. Chrome 124, M1 mac.
label: bug

title: Tests pass locally but fail in CI ~30% of the time
body: `auth.spec.ts` flakes with a 401. Same revision passes on a re-run. Looks like a race between the seeder and the first test.
label: bug

title: Support webhooks for the new `invoice.refunded` event
body: We already deliver `invoice.paid`; adding `invoice.refunded` would let us close the loop on chargebacks without polling.
label: feature

title: Better defaults for the retry policy
body: The current default (3 attempts, 100ms) is too aggressive for our upstream API. Could we default to 5 attempts with exponential backoff?
label: feature

title: It would be really nice if the import wizard also supported CSVs
body: We can already import JSON and Parquet. Adding CSV would unblock a chunk of users coming from spreadsheet workflows. Right now they hit a wall and bounce.
label: feature

title: How do I configure a custom retry policy?
body: I see a `retry` option in the docs but it's not clear how the backoff parameter works. Is the delay in ms or seconds?
label: question

title: What's the difference between mode: 'strict' and mode: 'lax'?
body: Both seem to validate input but the docs only describe `strict`. When would I want `lax`?
label: question

title: Why does the request hang when I pass an empty body?
body: If I `POST /jobs` with `{}`, the request hangs for 30s and then times out. Is that expected? I couldn't find anything about empty bodies in the README.
label: question

title: How do I deploy this to AWS Lambda?
body: Has anyone got this running on Lambda with the Node 20 runtime? Looking for a sample serverless.yml or SAM template.
label: question

title: Tutorial uses deprecated `createClient` signature
body: Step 3 of the getting-started tutorial passes `createClient(url, key)` but that signature was removed in v2. New form is `createClient({ url, key })`.
label: docs

title: Auth docs are correct but confusing
body: Everything in `/docs/auth` is technically accurate, but new users routinely think OAuth and JWT mode are mutually exclusive when they aren't. Could we add a worked example showing both together?
label: docs

title: No migration guide between v1 and v2
body: v2 is a major release with breaking changes (auth, config file format, default port). A `MIGRATING.md` would save a lot of issues from confused upgraders.
label: docs

title: Image upload times out for files larger than 50MB
body: We chunk on the client but the server-side merge step seems to load the whole file in memory before persisting. 50MB+ uploads timeout at the LB after 60s.
label: perf

title: CPU usage spikes to 100% during background sync
body: Every 5 minutes the sync worker pegs a core for ~30s. Profile shows we're re-parsing the same regex on every record. Worth caching.
label: perf

title: Memory regression after upgrading lodash to 4.17.22
body: Heap usage in the API server grew ~20% across the upgrade. Reverting lodash brings it back. Filing under perf — happy to re-categorize if it's actually a bug in our usage.
label: perf

title: Docs say to set `retries: -1` for infinite retries
body: Followed the README example, got `expected non-negative number`. Either the docs are wrong or the validator is. Reading the source, only `Infinity` is accepted — the docs example never worked.
label: docs

title: Could the JSON streaming parser go faster on 1GB inputs?
body: Current parser correctly handles 1GB files but takes ~4 minutes. Open to ideas — worker threads? a streaming approach? happy to PR if there's a direction you'd accept.
label: perf

title: How do I disable telemetry entirely?
body: Checked config, env vars, and the docs — I can't find a way to opt out of the metrics endpoint. We can't deploy this without disabling it. Would you accept a PR adding `telemetry: false`?
label: feature

title: v3 migration guide is missing the breaking-changes section
body: Other major-version guides have a Breaking section listing every change. v3's MIGRATING.md just links to the release notes, which aren't a complete list. New users keep tripping over removed APIs they didn't know about.
label: docs

title: App feels sluggish once a workspace has lots of files
body: Not a hard repro. With ~500 files in the tree, opening any panel takes 2-3 seconds. No CPU spike I could see, no errors in the console. Just laggy. Smaller workspaces are fine.
label: perf

title: ENOENT error following the quickstart in README
body: Ran `npx init` then `npm run build` exactly as the README shows. Got `ENOENT: no such file or directory, '.config.json'`. Looking at the source, init writes `config.json` (no dot prefix). The build itself is fine — the README is just stale.
label: docs

title: Search returns 504 on queries with >50k matches
body: Up to ~20k matches the endpoint is fine. Above that, the gateway times out at 60s. Server logs show the query completes correctly — but at 95s. So search isn't broken, it's just slow on large result sets.
label: perf

title: How do I set per-API-key rate limits?
body: Checked the docs and source — there's a global rate limit but no per-key knob. Is there a way to enable this, or does it need to be built? We have one customer doing 90% of our traffic.
label: feature

title: Why isn't `--quiet` mentioned anywhere in the docs?
body: Discovered the flag by reading the source. It's been there since v0.3 and is super useful for CI logs. Could it be added to the man page?
label: docs

title: Could we add response caching to `/lookup`?
body: Each call hits the DB even when the same key is queried repeatedly. ~80% of our requests are repeats within 60s. Latency on cache miss is fine — we're just doing more work than necessary. Code is correct, just wasteful.
label: perf

title: `Object.freeze(config)` breaks the library internally
body: Calling `Object.freeze` on the object returned by `getConfig()` crashes the next internal call: 'Cannot assign to read only property `defaults`'. The crash site is in `internal/applyDefaults.ts:33` — the library mutates the public-API return value to apply defaults. That seems wrong; public-API returns should be safe to freeze.
label: bug

title: Export action freezes the UI for 30 seconds
body: Click Export → page hangs, then download appears. We're serializing ~50MB on the main thread. The export produces the correct output — just at the cost of a 30s freeze. Needs to move off the main thread.
label: perf

title: Can I get a webhook when a job exceeds max retries?
body: Jobs go to 'failed' silently after exhausting retries. I want a callback. Couldn't find this in the docs or source — does it exist, or would I need to build it?
label: feature

title: README sample code produces a TypeScript error
body: Copy-pasting the README's quickstart: `const client = new Client({ apiKey })`. TypeScript errors: 'Property `baseUrl` is required'. The README wasn't updated for the breaking change in v2.0.
label: docs

title: Add a worked example for OAuth + custom scopes
body: The auth docs cover basic OAuth and list scopes separately, but no end-to-end example combining the two. Most teams (including us) end up trial-and-erroring. A worked example in `/docs/auth/scopes.md` would save hours.
label: docs

title: What's the rotation policy for the signing keys?
body: We're auditing for SOC2 and need to document this. Couldn't find anything about how often the JWT signing keys are rotated. Is there a public policy, or should I be reading the source?
label: question

title: Bulk delete times out for >500 records
body: Selecting 500+ rows and hitting Delete → 60s spinner, then a generic error. Smaller batches work fine. Probably we're serializing all IDs into one big query. Functionally correct, just doesn't scale.
label: perf

title: Is there a way to globally disable email notifications?
body: Per-user mute exists but no admin-level kill switch. We need to silence everything during scheduled maintenance windows. Couldn't find it anywhere.
label: feature
